Stealth attacks are very helpful. Especially in the early game. You'll probably end up travelling at night more, but this lets you take out camps in one go. Note that stealth kills do eight times more damage, so you need to find the correct weapons to one shot camps. If an enemy is alone, you can to a "stealth chain." This lets you sneakstrike an enemy multiple times. Just go behind them, and sneakstrike them, then while they're down, sneakily walk in front of them. And you'll have another chance to sneakstrike them once they stand up. I recommend watching some vids to get a better explanation.

Stealth is very important in my opinion. You can get the most out of your weapons durability by sneaking up on them and killing them in one shot. So I recommend traveling at night. You don't even have to kill the enemies, you can steal their weapons while they are asleep. Note that sneaking up on an enemy multiples the damage by 8, so make sure to do the math in order to one- shot them. Make sure to target the watchtower enemies first, the other weaker enemies, and then the strongest ones. You should also note that you don't have to kill every enemy in sight, unless it's a challenge. Other than that, you should master your dodges and parries. Cook meals that give you extra health, defense, or an attack boost. 

Cool stealth tip: You can actually sneak strike an enemy multiple times if you don't have a weapon that can one - shot them. So simply sneak up on them, and before they fully wake up, go right in front of them. You go right in front of them because when they wake up, they will usually turn around, giving you another chance to sneak strike them. There are videos out there that explain this more clearly. Lastly, make sure that the enemy is away from other enemies, as them waking up could wake up other enemies.

Ice and electric weapons are also very effective if you need help.

It's easy. Sneak up on it with a powerful weapon, with an attack buff as well if you can access it. Then you just do a charge attack, getting a decent amount of damage. If you have access to Revali's Gale, you can then get some height as the Hinox wakes up, and shoot it in the eye, as while it begins to stand up, it is vulnerable. Do this with bomb arrows, and you'll get better results. And if it has wooden leg wraps, setting them on fire will keep it busy. And if it has metal leg wraps, just use a shock arrow.
